engine: Phase1 GitHub-Only Quantitative Forecast Engine V1.8
mode: GitHub Actions near-live snapshot; refresh target every 5 minutes during U.S. regular market hours

sources.intraday: Twelve Data 15m primary; Yahoo Finance 15m automatic fallback on rate-limit/provider failure

freshness_rule: During regular hours, a Finnhub quote older than 180 seconds is marked stale and excluded from top candidates.

signal_policy: A signal candidate requires probability + 15m/4h/Day/Week alignment + fresh data + direction/horizon backtest edge. Otherwise the engine abstains.
ranking_basis: Candidates are ranked by current model probability; numeric targets are probability-weighted volatility forecasts; validation evidence is displayed separately.

data_resilience.policy: A temporary Twelve Data 429/provider failure must not erase otherwise usable ticker rows. Fallback usage is explicitly labeled and never presented as the primary source.

price_target_engine.method: probability-weighted directional edge combined with current daily ATR and square-root-of-time horizon scaling
price_target_engine.truth_note: These are model-implied quantitative targets, not guaranteed future prices. Validation status remains separate from the forecast itself.

production_model_policy.policy: A staged model may replace production only after its own historical evidence gate passes; otherwise the working probability/target engine remains active.
